scope: Revise planning requirements for affected package test restructuring and substantive command architecture/guide rewrites. No implementation starts in this step.
maintainer_direction: Many package tests may need to be rewritten; make that explicit in the impact assessment and REM. Documentation acceptance must cover rewriting/updating key command architecture portions in Friday Chat and Friday CLI, beyond a check pass.

clarifications.question: May affected tests be renamed, split or retired when obsolete, provided every still-valid behavioral requirement maps to retained or replacement coverage and each retirement has a documented reason?
Should the documentation work include one canonical command-architecture document for Chat, CLI/Runtime and the shared packages, alongside substantive updates to the affected Friday guide chapters?

test_boundary: Keep every still-valid requirement covered; allow justified affected-case/file/helper restructuring, replacement and retirement. Preserve old evidence, scope, safety and required acceptance witnesses; no unrelated suite rewrite or silent coverage reduction.
documentation_boundary: Canonical docs/architecture/command-execution.md for the implemented candidate plus substantive affected guide/package/schema/example updates, with semantic source/evidence review and verified examples. No current guide/architecture implementation in this planning step.

review_budget.continuation: Changed governing requirements require a fresh candidate review within the standing four-total-round cap; earlier verdicts remain candidate-specific. Maintainer reviews linked documents in parallel.
review_budget.threshold: Each Sol/Astra/Opus seat VERIFIED, zero mandatory findings, coverage and overall each >=9.5. Stop after round4 for guidance if unmet.

lightweight_change_exemption.reason: Explicit revision of planning documents and bounded independent document review; no runtime behavior changes now.
lightweight_change_exemption.scope: Named plans, REM/assessment/criteria, current authority/routing and append-only evidence only.
lightweight_change_exemption.validation: Document/source-feasibility council and focused board/dashboard, lifecycle/link, metadata, whitespace and preservation checks.

authority_not_granted: Gate-A installs, downloads or model/provider/store operations
maintainer package-impact satisfaction or construction directive approval
